Name: Crops Sold At Pierre's
Author: rosechove
Description:
[b][color=#ff7700]Description[/color][/b]
﻿
Added crops to Pierre's General Store. Only in-season produce will be available, including the new 1.6 items (carrots, etc.). 

I tried my best to keep the prices balanced, so you can't make money reselling the produce, but should still turn a small profit with artisan goods. 
[list]
[/list][b][color=#ff7700]Installation Instructions[/color][/b]

Unzip file and drag into Mods folder. 
[b]
[color=#ff7700]Edit Prices[/color]
[/b]
Prices can be configured in "Shops" file. Open json file using text editor and change "StockPrice" value. 

[color=#ff7700][b]Requirements[/b] [/color]

This mod requires min version [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5005]Shop Tile Framework[/url]﻿ 1.0.10.

Downloads.Description: Requires Shop Tile Framework 1.0.10-alpha.20240227 or later.
